note: One source for network rules. Read by Terraform (network.tf) and by scripts/check-network-rules.mjs. Add a public port here only with a decision record. AWS: subnet_p_cidr (platform) and subnet_i_cidr (labs) are two subnets in the VPC (D-43); subnet_cidr is the older single subnet that the Oracle option still uses. egress_common is the outbound allowlist of both hosts; private_ingress rules also become outbound rules on the from-side host. Token $ssh_source_cidrs = the SSH source list; token $public_web_cidrs = the web source list (default: the same as SSH; 0.0.0.0/0 only when set on purpose).

egress_common.name: https
egress_common.description: Image pulls, certificates, apt over https

egress_common.name: apt-http
egress_common.description: apt mirrors still use http on the Ubuntu image; switched off with labs_apt_http_egress = false

public_ingress.name: ssh
public_ingress.description: SSH, key-only, from the listed source addresses

icmp_ingress.name: path-mtu
icmp_ingress.description: Path MTU discovery (ICMP type 3 code 4); not a port

private_ingress.name: orchestrator-mtls
private_ingress.description: Platform calls the orchestrator (architecture 02, F-07); proposal until S-17 and L-13 confirm

private_ingress.name: ingest-internal
private_ingress.description: Orchestrator reports and relayed events to the ingest internal listener (F-08, F-13); port is a proposal until IF-4 confirms
